content: “Ina-ama, ina-nara miy hononmi maka aguh idma-riama lia'armi. Awuak pa agheri-ghelta a ino'nu la' miy. Awuak pa mtia'wa reri tlinmi mai a'u.”
Yoma ratlina Paulus naltier die nnairi yawala Ibrani, pede yeher to' pa mtulu-mtie'ela re. Paulus nakot la

“A' di de riy Yahudi id a'u. A i'nu ntor a lia Tarsus noha-rai Kilikia. Mere ramori-ralawna a lia mai Yerusalem la handi, me tungkuru Gamaliel mak kwatutga plu'unu-plehenu a lia' deulu-tatra maka Musa nala la it upni-tgarni. Emolmolan walia miy hononmi la'a ler di wali, aghu'ru-ghelam matmiati Uplerlawna deullu-tatarni honona.
Aniahora-niala'a la'pa awunu-wuenna riy mak klelernohora Yesus yala'ani de. La'pa patke'a rora muanke'a, honona rde atiorna pa awui'ita la roma nhio'la.

Imam o'ta lawna, me ina-ama honona mak ktorna agama watghudni pena rtutrier wial (saksi) pia rat niohora a hihi'u-yapya'pu. Yoma ir er mak kala horta-hairi pa agodia la Yahudi mak kden la Damsik. Atiorreria horat re totpena awuatorna riy makpesiay Yesus ne agodi muai Yerusalem di pa rukmua.
La' lerni mak a lia Damsik de, pa tre' ma't oke' pa alier la Damsik, la' lera nwawuau ro'onni, dewade plinu-plinnianamde tlen lawna ida layarni la lyanti pa nle'lu reri a'u.
Dewade a'upru'wu tar lia tani wawannu pa utlina lira id nakot mai a'u: “Saulus, Saulus ee! Hya' nrei pia omumuki-muma'al A'u?!”
Noma a'utiana: “He' o'a Matroma?” “Yesus. A'g inhatti. Riy Nasaret mak omumuki-muma'al de.”
Agor rewre'wa riy mak kden hande mamkeka tlen lawan de. Mere ir edonna rna'erit nana lir mak kaltier mai a'u.
Noma utian owa'ana: “Hota hya' maka aghi'a Matromlawnu ne?” Noma Itmatromlawanni Nakot mai a'u: “Mumat doin la pa mlier la Damsik. La'a hande nanpena Uplerlawna na Nakot o kniarmu.”
A ma'tu npona, yoma tlena lipni-layarni nweyat targa. Noma a mutwua'lu re rnahemna a'u pua amler la leta Damsik ralamni.
Riy id la hande de nwawa Ananias. E' de riy plele'era ne natlina-natail la'a deulu-tatra Musa. La' walia riy Yahudi honona la'a Damsik de ratu ra'unni-ramta'ata de. Enmai pia namkek a'u,
noma ntutrier lia a wa'lu pa nakot mai a'u: “Saulus, hyalia, mpuer matmu.” La'a mtatande nekpa umkek nan e'a.

Noma nakot mai a'u de niwra: “Hyalia, Uplerlawna la it upni-tgarni ed mak kwalir o' totpena omuat niohora E yala'ani. Ne totpa mumkek la Riy Ploloi-Plele'era mak Uplerlawna Nano'targa pa Namori-nalewna rimormiori me totpa mutlin nana E lirni.
Hota o' ed mak ktutrier (saksi) pa mukot nohora la riy honona la'a hya' maka mumkeka ne hya' maka mutlina.
Dodo'ondi yana ralammu worworga. Mupriri, ne mlia' pa rhara'nu. Mpuol lia Itmatromni, totpena Namou-nawitna do'omu-halmu.””
Uplerlawna Nhopan pa Paulus nakot nohora Yesus yala'ani la riy maka Yahudi atia'a
“A'uwal lia Yerusalem, ne la'pa asiumbain rer lia' Uplerlawna roma kreini, de Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli Napenga a ralmu pa
a'umkek nana Itmatromni noma Nakot mai a'u: “Mupleta! Mliergot la Yerusalem diwa. Yoma hota riy mak kden la handi edonna ratlin la hya' maka omukot nohora la'a A wawnu.”
Noma awuahla: “Edonna emkade Matroma, hota ratlin mai a'u, yoma irat muemna la a' die ed mak kwahu'ru Yahudi kreini-iskolli genni re pa atioran makpesiaya O'a re pa aliwra-kaklia re.
Nhi' wal pia Stefanus mak kakot nohora O lirmu de rwenan nana, de atiutrier wiali me awuayow wal pia rwen e'a. A'g ed mak katiaka mak kwenna re rayanni.”
Mere Itmatromni Nakot owa'an la mai a'u: “Mlia'awa, yoma hota A'g ed mak khopan pa omlia'a gen miaka oliet memna, la'a riy maka Yahudi atia'a.””

Riy harahu mak katlina re edonna rwadur ma'ta la genni. Mere la'awa honi pa Paulus nakot nohora niwra Uplerlawna Nhopan pa Paulus nla nakot nohora Uplerlawna lirni la Yahudi atia'a, dewade rawenan doin la, nhi'nande rhaun pa riwra: “Mpienna, mpienna riy mak emkade. Yana twayow pa nmormiori.”
Rawenan pa rhaun reri tio'owa, ne ro'lu rain lawan wamueheni re pa rkakna, me rnaklia koda-awu la' heyanna.

Dewade Komandan la makodia keki-rautu la Roma nhopan pa rodia Paulus la makodi keki-rautu yatiak genni totpena rnairi ha ulti pa rliwra-rkaklia ne ratian nohora plolli-halli. Hya' mak krei pede Yahudi re polpuolu-hawaunia re?

Mere la'pa rwutga Paulus pa riwa rliwra, noma Paulus nakot la o'ta-mata la makodi keki-rautu rahu ida mak ktutrier lia hande: “Hairi Roma deullu-tatarni nwayow nohora pa makden hairi Roma, la'pa edonna rat mua'ta plolli-halli de rliwra-rkaklia?!”
Makodi keki-rautu rahu ida o'tani natlin nana dewade nla nakota la e' o'tani niwra: “Matroma, hota itsi' hya'a? Riy di mak kden la hair lawna Roma id e'a.”
Noma o'tani de nla'a Paulus de pa natiana niwra: “Mukot nohora teka, o' di de makden Roma id o'a?” Noma Paulus nwayowa niwra: “A' di de makdena hair lawna Roma molanni id a'u.”
O'tani de nakot owa'ana: “La'pa agiwra u'itra-ulawan la Roma mutnu de, apuair werwerta.” Noma Paulus nakot la: “Mere a' di de rtetia a horu-rki'ira a kliawtu la' Roma.”

La'pa ratlin tutga Paulus lirni dewade makodia keki-rautu mak kiwra katiana Paulus plolli-halli re honona rwadura, ne o'tani mana namta'at wenan wali yoma e' ed mak kenia ranti la Paulus limni. Natniekamde Paulus de Roma atia' de.
Rodi Paulus la krei Yahudi o'tani-matni

O'tani la makodi keki-rautu re nahak pa nat muemna hya'a rerieini pa Yahudi rwaghala Paulus. La hade pede repar noma nhopan pa rpolga imam-imam o'tani-matni honona, ror rewre'wa o'ta-mata mak ktorna agama watghudni re korni honona pa rma rawoka. Me nwe'er doin Paulus pa nodia la ir honona gaini.
